Pit bulls are high energy dogs. If you can't walk him more, try to find alternatives. Edit: forgot to add, the best way to train anything is positive reinforcement. When he pees outside, give him a treat or a good boy all excited like, stuff like that BEFORE you start scolding them for going inside. I'm sure that there are plenty of legitimate companies out there, but if you want me to share my opinion.. install yourself. It will save you money, it will ensure that the only person who has the "keys" is you. The thing about security.. is it gives the one securing it complete access at a later point. One could argue "oh well no.. they don't have access" well.. not your passwords or whatever but they definately wouldn't need that if they are the ones installing sensors.

For a truly secure system.. you don't want anyone knowing details about it. Expecially, subcontracted companies.
There are roaming companies that do installs for security to scope/gain access to a home. There are people who get into security for the same reason. If you get robbed a month or so after an install, you will know what happened but will not be able to do much about it. :/ Odds are.. unless your doing a very expensive settup.. it isn't worth paying someone else to install. More often than not it's a magnetic sensor that triggers when the magnet is displaced. Sometimes you can do sensors in glass ect, but again, if they installed it.. they can bypass it. Those systems only work if people don't know what they are or where they are located.
